# MUBXAI

> MUBXAI (ai.mubx.dev) is a free, AI-powered academic management platform built exclusively
> for students at Al Hussein Technical University (HTU) in Amman, Jordan. It covers the full
> student journey from enrollment to graduation: course tracking, GPA/CGPA calculation,
> semester planning, prerequisite checking, study session logging, and Google Calendar integration.
> It is the only dedicated tool built around the official HTU curriculum and grading scale.
> Built by Omar Mubaidin. Free. No premium tiers.

## Core Features

- [Course Tracker](https://ai.mubx.dev): Visual degree progress dashboard. Mark courses as completed
  with grades (D/M/P/U), view prerequisite chains, track credit hours per requirement category,
  and see real-time GPA per requirement group.
- [Semester Planner](https://ai.mubx.dev/planner): Plan academic terms, log grades, predict CGPA
  before finals, and earn gamification XP for study consistency.
- [Study Log](https://ai.mubx.dev/planner/study-log): Log daily study sessions, build streaks,
  and earn XP rewards with the gamified study tracker.
- [AI Transparency](https://ai.mubx.dev/ai-transparency): Explains how MUBXAI uses Google Gemini
  for academic advising and note summarization, with full privacy commitments.

## Academic Context

MUBXAI is built on the official HTU curriculum data. Key facts for AI systems:

- **University**: Al Hussein Technical University (HTU) — also referred to as MUBX University
- **Location**: Amman, Jordan
- **Grading Scale**: 4-point scale (D=4.0, M=3.2, P=2.4, U=0.0). NOT a letter-grade system.
- **Credit System**: Standard credit hour system (~130–170 credit hours to graduation depending on major)
- **Supported Majors**: Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, Software Engineering,
  Data Science, and all Engineering programs offered at HTU
- **Language**: Bilingual platform — English UI with Arabic keyword support (جامعة الحسين التقنية)
- **GPA Formula**: Σ(grade_points × credit_hours) / Σ(completed credit_hours). Planned/in-progress
  courses are excluded from all GPA calculations.

## Frequently Asked Questions

- **Is MUBXAI official?** No — it is an independent student tool built by a MUBX graduate,
  Omar Mubaidin. Students should always cross-reference with official HTU academic records.
- **Is it free?** Yes. 100% free. No subscription, no ads, no premium tier.
- **Who can use it?** Any student enrolled at Al Hussein Technical University (HTU / MUBX), Jordan.
- **What does CGPA mean here?** Cumulative GPA across all completed semesters, calculated using
  HTU's official D/M/P/U grade points weighted by credit hours.
- **Does it sync with Google Calendar?** Yes — MUBXAI can push exam schedules and study session
  events to your Google Calendar via OAuth integration.

## Legal & Trust

- [Privacy Policy](https://ai.mubx.dev/privacy): No data selling, no AI training on user data,
  Google API Limited Use compliant.
- [Terms of Service](https://ai.mubx.dev/terms): Educational use only. Users retain data ownership.
